senses.gloss:
ind. [इदं-ह इशादेशः [[P. V. 3. 11]] [[Sk.]]] 
__1 Here (referring to time, place or direction); in this place or case. नेहाभिकमनाशोऽस्ति [[Bg. 2. 40.]] 
__2 In this world (opp. परत्र or अमुत्र); oft. with जगति; [[K. 35.]] 
__3 In this case; in this book or system. 
__4 Now, at this time. [cf. Zend. idha]. 
-Comp. 
-अमुत्र ind. in this world and the next world, here and there; cf. इहामुत्रार्थभोगबिरागः । शाङ्करभाष्य on ब्रह्मसूत्र 1. 1. 1. 
-आगत a. come here. 
-इह ind. here and there, now and then, repeatedly. °मातृ a. 
__1 whose mother is here and there; that is, everywhere; समानो बां जनिता भ्रातरा युवं यमाविहेहमातरा [[Rv. 6. 59. 2.]] 
__2 of whose mothers one is here and one there. 
-कालः this life. 
-कतु, -चित्त a. whose intentions or thoughts are centred in this world or place, इहैवैधि धनसनिरिहचित्त इहकतुः [[Av. 18. 4. 38.]] 
-भव or 
-तन a. belonging to this world. 
-लोकः this world or life; °के in this world; cf. श्रेयो भोक्तुंभैक्ष्यमपीह लोके [[Bg. 2. 5.]] 
-समये ind. here, now, at such a time as this. 
-स्थ a. standing here. 
-स्थान a. one whose residence is on the earth.

[ईह्-अ] 
__1 Wish, desire; जलनिधिमकरोत्तरीतुमीहाम् [Page0395-1] [[Rām.]]; cf. also हन्तुं कोधवशादीहां चकाते नौ परस्परम् [[Ki.]] see अनीह also. 
__2 An undertaking, act. 
__3 Effort, exertion, activity; ईहातश्चेद्धनं भवेत् [[Ms. 9. 205]]; प्रजागरांचकारारेरीहास्वनिशमादरात् [[Bk. 6. 2.]] 
-Comp. 
-अर्थिन् a. aiming at any object, seeking wealth; वैश्यस्येहार्थिनोऽष्टमे (कार्यम्) [[Ms. 2. 37.]] 
-मृगः [ईहाप्रधानो मृगः] 
__1 a wolf; सुकृतेहामृगाकीर्णम् [[Rām. 2. 15. 35.]] 
__2 an artificial deer. 3 a division [Page0395-2] of the drama consisting of four acts; for definition &c. see [[S. D. 518]] = वृकः a wolf.
a. [इह-त्यप्] Being here, of this place or world.
